title: Arisen melee brain: approach, attack chains, skills, wait
intro: About 1 minute. Change the Arisen to Fighter, Thief, Warrior or Mystic Spearhand first. Open flat ground, no enemies. The dummy is a goblin that cannot die and stands still.

steps.text: 1/2 MELEE BRAIN. Arisen must be a FIGHTER, THIEF, WARRIOR or MYSTIC SPEARHAND. Open flat ground, face clear space, no enemies. Press End (a dummy appears 10 m ahead and you become the main pawn)
You are the pawn: step aside and WATCH THE ARISEN. Does he run in, face the dummy, chain attacks, use skills?

expect.label: brain switched on for this vocation

steps.text: 2/2 WAIT. Press WAIT (pawn order) so the Arisen stays, then walk your pawn 15 m away. Press End: a new dummy appears 10 m from the Arisen; he should NOT chase it
Arisen waiting: he should stay put (dummy 10 m from him)

expect.label: (info) share of time approaching while told to wait (should be 0)

steps.text: Done: dummy removed, releasing. Press FOLLOW afterwards
